# Eventual

> Eventual is a free, open-source expense-splitting app built for Indian rupees, with 20 supported currencies. Log what everyone paid on trips, in shared flats and on nights out; Eventual splits each bill evenly, by exact amounts, by shares or by percent, and tells each person who to pay and how much, down to the last paisa. It runs as a web app at https://eventual.macintushar.xyz, as a native iPhone and Android app built from source, and through a REST API, TypeScript SDK and MCP server.

Key facts:

- Free. No paid plans, no ads. Source: https://github.com/macintushar/eventual. Anyone can self-host it.
- Groups are private: only invited members see a group's expenses, balances and history.
- Shares always add up: INR 1,000 split three ways is INR 333.34, 333.33 and 333.33.
- Once someone marks their share paid, the expense locks so the settled amount can't change.
- Balances are simplified into as few transfers as possible, per currency. Amounts are never converted between currencies.
- Supported currencies: INR, USD, EUR, GBP, AED, AUD, CAD, CHF, CNY, HKD, JPY, KRW, KWD, MYR, NPR, NZD, SAR, SGD, THB, VND.
- Eventual records who owes whom. It does not move money; the mobile app can hand off to a UPI app to pay.
- Every app uses the same API, so an expense logged in one shows up in all the others.

## Apps

- Web app: https://eventual.macintushar.xyz. Works in any modern browser on desktop or phone.
- iPhone and Android app: native Expo app in `apps/mobile`. Not in the App Store or Google Play yet; build it from source. It signs in to the hosted service or any self-hosted Eventual server. Setup: https://github.com/macintushar/eventual/tree/main/apps/mobile
- Apple Shortcuts: log an expense from iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch or Siri, including from a bank SMS. https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/docs#shortcut

## Help

- [Help center](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/help): FAQ on groups, invites, roles, split methods, locked expenses, settling up, password reset, the mobile app and integrations
- [How do I create a group?](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/help/create-a-group): step-by-step guide with screenshots
- [How do I add an expense?](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/help/add-an-expense): step-by-step guide covering split methods

## Developers

- [Integrations](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/docs): the mobile app, Apple Shortcut, MCP setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Hermes and OpenClaw, the TypeScript SDK and the REST API
- MCP server: `https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). Authenticate with `x-api-key: <your-api-key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>`, using an API key created at https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/app/settings/api-keys
- MCP tools: `listGroups` (your groups and balance in each), `listExpenses` (recent expenses in a group), `createExpense` (log an expense with any split method), `getBalances` (who owes whom, with simplified transfers)
- REST API: `/api/v1`, same API keys. [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/api/openapi.json)
- TypeScript SDK: `@eventual/sdk` (typed fetch client for browsers, Node, Bun and React Native) and `@eventual/schemas` (Zod schemas for every request and response). In the repo under `packages/`; not published to npm. https://github.com/macintushar/eventual/tree/main/packages/sdk
